groups.observed: Four thick curved sectors forming a complete ring, separated by short straight gaps; multiple concentric outlines and dashed circulating orbit are visible.
Top and bottom rectangular acceleration blocks; top diagonal leader terminates inside the top block.
Horizontal left inlet with small rectangular components enters the left gap. Short oblique right outlet branches from the right gap.

Four source label groups: acceleration device above, inlet at left, magnet label at lower left with leader into its sector, and vertical particle-beam outlet label at right. All labels have visible clearance.

Small detached printed marker below the ring, plus a few faint source specks. Preserve its exact visible footprint; it is not reliably readable as a Latin letter in this crop. The user-named source a marker is assessed for retention, not relabeled or used to resolve figure ownership.
Apparatus and internal labels are inset from the image boundaries. No external body text or separate caption intrudes.

pages.dimension_note: The earlier RAW report lists crop-box dimensions 470x456. The current hash-identical PNG IHDR and SVG dimensions are 494x480. This review binds the actual files without editing the historical report.

groups.observed: Large elliptical accelerator fills the foreground; inner and outer ring contours, repeated equipment blocks and supports remain distinguishable.
Diagonal staircase and rails descend from middle-left toward the foreground, with the steps and adjacent apparatus visible.
Curved ceiling ribs and overhead structure, central columns and upper machinery, rear wall/window bands and vertical side supports remain visible.
Dark/light patterns preserve the dense equipment, cabling and structural texture across the center, left bay and right-hand ring.
The source crop's full historical photograph silhouette and white outer margin are visible, with no adjacent body text, caption, figure label or footnote.
